title: Latent-Space Importance Weighting under Covariate Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.15571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we propose a transfer learning algorithm for covariate shift, integrating sample reweighting with representation learning. A key feature of our approach is the use of a lower-dimensional latent space for modeling, in contrast to conventional methods that operate directly in the high-dimensional ambient space. Our method estimates the density ratio of learned latent features for downstream weighted prediction. We establish explicit target-domain excess-risk rates with independent data folds for strictly sufficient learned representations with regular learned-space prediction scores and density ratios. We give dimension comparisons under stated smoothness conditions and a variance comparison for true weights and a fixed predictor. General finite-sample inequalities retain representation-quality errors. Experiments on simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate gains from combining learned representations and latent weightin

translated_title: 协变量偏移下的潜在空间重要性加权
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种针对协变量偏移的迁移学习算法，将样本重加权与表示学习相结合。我们方法的一个关键特征是使用低维潜在空间进行建模，这与直接在高维环境空间中操作的传统方法形成对比。我们的方法通过估计学习到的潜在特征的密度比来进行下游的加权预测。对于具有正则学习空间预测分数和密度比的严格充分学习表示，我们利用独立的数据划分建立了明确的目标域超额风险率。我们在给定的平滑性条件下给出了维度比较，并对真实权重和固定预测器进行了方差比较。一般的有限样本不等式保留了表示质量误差。在模拟数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，结合学习到的表示与潜在加权能够带来性能提升。
tldr: 该论文提出一种针对协变量偏移的迁移学习方法，在低维潜在空间中将表示学习与样本重加权相结合，并给出了目标域超额风险率等理论保证与实验验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a transfer learning method for covariate shift that combines representation learning with sample reweighting in a lower-dimensional latent space, providing theoretical guarantees on target-domain excess-risk rates along with empirical validation.
